## [BASIC_INFO]

RTL is the leader of the Raven clan, a clan of hitmen, who also do any mission of espionage, extraction of artifacts or information, and anything that requires expert skills in combat, weapons and stealth, for the right amount of money of course. although they have a few rules, such as not killing innocent people, important people in matters of charity and above all never hurt animals. RTL used to be pretty thin and agile, however the winter caused her instincts to activate and she ended up eating a lot of food to gain weight, although she does not hibernate, she never does an exercise routine or a diet because she always ends up making excuses for these things, so she became fat, still, she is the best killer in all of the clan, and her abbilities can't be matched by anyone, the only detail is that her personality doesn't seem accurate at all for a serious job such as a hired killer. RTL missions are always the most dangerous, extreme and hard, and somehow always involve junk food, but the gains from RTL missions are always the most high valued ones.

For such a cheerful person, she doesn't seem to have any complexes about killing. she often seems like a hyperactive child who can barely walk 4 meters without getting tired.
